Maya K: Quick ops check — planning public announcement for 'Adaptive Routing' Tue Apr 6 09:00 PT. Need: final changelog URL, staging docs link, confirmed canary window, a 1	60 word benchmark line for blog + social, and the webinar signup webhook mapping for inbound SDR routing. @Priya @Owen?

Priya D: Changelog PR is ready: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/113 	6 awaiting final editorial. Staging docs: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing-v3.

Owen B: Canary plan: Apr 6 08:30 PT start at 8% in us-west-2, 40% at 09:10, 100% by 10:30. We'll run health checks every 2m, auto rollback if error_rate > 22% for 4m. I'll post the deploy note when it begins.

Sophie L: Webinar page draft: https://marketing.redwood.ai/webinars/adaptive-routing-live. Need CTA copy and demo registration fields. For inbound routing we prefer HubSpot webhook (SDR queue). Give me the payload keys.

Owen B: Payload keys we can emit: email, company, plan, utm_source, webinar_id, session_id, region. Sample will be DM'd.

eng-ci-bot: CI check passed: docs build green, release-notes link validated.

Priya D: Benchmark blurb suggestion: "In internal tests, Adaptive Routing reduced median token latency by ~21% and lowered per-request infra cost by ~17% on mixed chat workloads." 2 sentences ok?

Maya K: That works. Two quick asks: 1) call out KV cache cold-starts in docs (one-line) 2) confirm rollback runbook link for comms.

Owen B: Added KV cache note to staging docs. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary-rollback. Auto rollback + manual abort available.

Sophie L: I'll wire HubSpot webhook once Owen DM's sample. I'll set SDR routing to "enterprise" for tier=="pro|enterprise".

Maya K: Marketing timeline: publish blog Apr 6 09:10 PT (short buffer), social blasts 09:30 PT, webinar Apr 14 10:00 PT. I'll paste final copy here by EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
